name: Yu
source: Yu is the heroine of this novel. [spoiler]She claims to be a cheap home robot and takes the initiative to become the male-character's maid, but in fact she is a human pretending to be a robot. At the end of the visual novel, she became the male-character's sister.[/spoiler]
